plainText:
Maggie McDowell is an American voice actress for the English-language dub of .

==Biography==
McDowell became a voice actress, with her first role being on . She voiced Miette, 's rival in Pokémon Showcases, during . She also voiced some minor roles in Unlocking Some Respect! and Master Class Is in Session!.
